files.title: Video URLs
files.description: Direct links to the videos. Accepted: MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI, M4V, 3GP, FLV, WMV, MPEG-TS and most others ffmpeg reads.

format.title: Output format
enumTitles: WebM (VP9 + Opus, smaller, for the web)

quality.title: Compression
quality.description: Constant-quality encoding: the file is as small as the chosen quality allows.

resolution.title: Max resolution
resolution.description: Caps the short side (height of a landscape video). Smaller videos are never enlarged. 720p is a good choice for WhatsApp and email.

fps.title: Max frame rate
fps.description: Leave empty to keep the original. For GIF the default is 12.

removeAudio.title: Remove audio
removeAudio.description: Mute the video (also makes it smaller).

keepMetadata.title: Keep metadata
keepMetadata.description: Off by default: GPS location, device and date tags are removed.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger files are skipped with an error (not charged). Give the run more memory for very large files.
